exceptions.rationale: The advisory applies to React Router RSC mode. The OpenWA dashboard is a Vite-built browser-only SPA using BrowserRouter and has no React Server Components, server actions, or server request handler.
compensatingControls: Exact react-router-dom version pin and committed lockfile
Automated scan rejects RSC and server-action APIs
Dashboard is served as static client assets
Weekly package advisory review until a patched release is published
